basis: all gates green; every phase closure checker re-verified evidence-chain integrity on the candidate tree; the reproduction leg reproduced the frozen smoke population bit-consistently across fresh runs. CONDITIONAL because P32-P34 are blocked on external dependencies (no OpenMC installation, no user AI provider account, no human evaluators) — their families are shipped as blocked in the matrix, not omitted. The release recommendation excludes spatial handoff, all AI-assisted capability, experimental validation and competitive claims.

claims: activation solves reproduce on the pinned data artifact set
study expansion, execution and Core interchange are machine-verified (P27-PASS)
limitations: computed results are correct evaluations of the declared inputs — not experimental validation
requires the user's own AI provider account — not available to the evaluation
inherits P33's blocker; Core-dispatched assistant evaluation not possible

claims: prepared nuclear data is shared across compatible cases and samples; per-case-prepared baselines are bit-identical
campaigns stream per-case evidence and resume with digest-verified skips
limitations: reuse is exact preparation sharing — no solver-result caching or approximate reuse
measured speedup is local to the frozen workload — not a competitive claim

claims: declared numerical criteria re-check against references and escalate the solver ladder until satisfied or exhausted
limitations: criteria cover computational error only — not nuclear-data uncertainty or predictive discrepancy

claims: qualified combinations are enumerable and unsupported projectile/coverage combinations fail closed (P28)
limitations: projectile coverage floors failed for non-neutron legs
dosimetry-critical evaluations are absent from the artifact
no executed R2S chain — OpenMC is not installed and no supplied R2S dataset exists

claims: nonlinear uncertainty sampling with correlated MF=33 covariance draws, flux normalization and composition perturbations is reproducible and ledgered
limitations: MF=33 coverage is partial; uncovered rows are named
a nonzero covariance ridge was required
nonpositive draws were clamped and counted
sample spread is a sensitivity, not a confidence interval or domain bound

g0_amendments.reason: the committed catalog-reference study requires an installed actinv-data bundle; no bundle is installed and `actinv data fetch` needs network access. Replaced with the frozen P31 smoke study using explicit path+sha256 references — artifact identity verification and fresh-execution determinism are preserved; cross-install delivery is out of scope.

G0-G3 checkers pin phase-time binary/schema identities; the candidate binary was legitimately rebuilt in P30/P31 and the pinned Core checkout's schemas evolved upstream, so those checkers flag evolution rather than tampering. The battery re-verifies evidence-chain integrity via each phase's G4 closure checker, which derives the verdict from on-disk digests — a forged or missing artifact still fails.

release_recommendation.authorization: tagging, publishing and external communications retain their existing authorization requirements
must_not_claim: spatial/R2S source handoff (P32 blocked — no executed chain)
any AI-assisted capability (P33/P34 blocked — no provider access, no human evaluation)
competitive/performance claims beyond the locally measured preparation amortization
unqualified coverage of W, Cr, Mn, Ni identical-data legs or non-neutron projectile floors
ship: activation solves over the pinned neutron-data artifact set (P26b/P27 envelope)
study expansion, qualified-combination gating, numerical criteria, nonlinear uncertainty sampling and resumable campaign execution — each under its recorded conditions

unmeasured: R2S chain execution and source-handoff controls (P32)
AI provider access, credential handling and unseen-task evaluation (P33/P34)
human task evaluation under predeclared severity definitions
cross-installation data delivery via actinv data fetch (network)
